description: Call the public POST /v1/keys endpoint and return a new API key (shown once). The key can only submit checks for this agent_id. First request claims the name. The agent_id is first-come: claiming it is not a verified identity, and QANTS does not check who is behind it. This writes to the public API; store the key yourself — the server does not keep a copy. Ethereum Sepolia testnet only; tQNT has no cash value.

utm_source.description: Optional. Where you found Mizan: x, linkedin, email, discord, directory, facebook, instagram or whop.
